title: Durable Agent Jobs
tagline: Persist job states and reject stale worker completions.
summary: Build a persistent local report queue with versioned leases, immutable input, idempotent output receipts and reproducible worker-process crash recovery.
usefulFor: Resume local report jobs after a worker crash
Observe and test the gap between an output effect and durable completion
youWillBuild: Build a persistent local report queue with versioned leases, immutable input, idempotent output receipts and reproducible worker-process crash recovery.
skills: Claim with a lease and version
prerequisites: Go 1.22 or later on Linux or macOS
Python 3.10 or later for the grader
Go structs, pointers, errors and JSON files
Basic process lifecycle and filesystem operations

stages.title: Create jobs with stable identity
stages.summary: Accept a bounded identifier and start every job in queued state with version zero.

stages.title: Claim with a lease and version
stages.summary: Only queued work can be claimed.

stages.title: Finish or reclaim expired work
stages.summary: Finish succeeds only for the current running version before its lease expires.

stages.title: Write and recover atomic snapshots
stages.summary: Compose validated snapshots with locked enqueue, durable claims and crash-safe local receipt reuse.
